query: What studio album did Kanye West record with Roc-A-Fella Records and soul singer Dwele?

pipeline_result.response: Kanye West recorded a studio album titled "Roc-A-Fella" with Roc-A-Fella Records, which is an American music label. The album was released on June 10, 2015 as part of the "Rock & Roll" series and featured the songs "The Big Sick," "I'm Gonna Be Your Man," and "Roc-A-Fella."
